name: grid-subgrid-empty-edge-placeholder
derivation: Only the middle track contains an item, width19. The subgrid has13px left padding and an empty fixed5px first track. Its left-edge hypothetical item spans tracks1-2 with contribution19+13=32, requiring the auto middle track to be32-5=27. The right-edge placeholder adds no padding and does not enlarge it. Root width is5+27+7=39. The real child still starts at inherited line2, local x5, because it is not on the subgrid edge; the hypothetical item affects sizing, not the real child's placement. Its fixed19px width leaves8px unused in the middle track.
